description: Co-op with AI buddies from a hosted Room (Mike, 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17, T-NETWORKING-007). A listen host alone in its Room starts co-op Defection on Agent through the Room's lobby start (--host-autostart, mode coop, --host-autostart-peers 0) with the Partner choice set to 2 simulants (--coop-ai-buddies 2). The co-op stage start has one player, so it takes the buddies, clamped to the original's limit: a fresh profile has no co-op completions, so one buddy on every difficulty (getMaxAiBuddies). The buddy spawns at the player as in the original (playerTick, GAILIST_INIT_DEFAULT_BUDDY), the mission plays to its debug end at 40 s (--debug-end-mission, every objective complete) and the results show. Written 2026-11-17; port 27269.

input_sequence.comment: The host's own lobby start, ready gate, stage load and spawn with no client.
Usable control, with one bounded Skip if the authored intro owns input.
The host's results, after --debug-end-mission ends the mission at 40 s.
Scripted clean exit 4 s (script time) after the results.

required_lines: BOOT: --host-autostart firing: mode=1 stage='base:defection' difficulty=0 anti_client=255 scenario=0 timelimit=0 sims=0
PLAYER\.INIT\.COMMIT lobby-start room=\d+ mode=1 players=1 bots=0
NET: starting co-op stage 0x[0-9a-f]+ difficulty 0 with 1 players
PLAYER\.INIT\.COMMIT coop-stage players=1 bond=0 coop=-1 anti=-1
COOP\.AIBUDDIES: host alone=1 buddies=1 requested=2 max=1 difficulty=0
